newsitem.title: USA: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE OFF $1 AT $105/DRESSED - USDA.
newsitem.headline: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE OFF $1 AT $105/DRESSED - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were near steady, USDA said. Dressed sales were steady to $1.00 per cwt lower. Buyer inquiry fairly good. Seller interest fair. Wk To Date- 29,500 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 94,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 121,000.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1325 lbs - 65.50-66.00; dressed basis mostly 105.00, instances 106.00 on predominately Choice. ( weighted average 105.14).
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1225 lbs - 65.25-66.00; dressed basis 105.00, few predominately Choice 106.00 ( weighted average 105.02).
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
